description: This file defines a PHP class TimezoneAPI within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for the installer API module. It provides a REST endpoint to retrieve timezone data, utilizing helper classes and extending a base REST controller.

classes.name: TimezoneAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller for retrieving timezone data during installation.
